value.title: Luke Cage S2#13
value.text: With Mariah in jail, Shades walks into the barbershop to warn Luke that other gangs are moving on Harlem and urges him to take over himself.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's old enforcer. Urges him to take over Harlem.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Hears his warning about Harlem but doesn't trust him.

verdicts.why: The scene is right (Shades warns Luke about the Carbones and Puerto Rican mob and urges him to take over; Luke doesn't believe him), but nothing in the title clearly turns them from enemies: Luke still distrusts him and Shades ends up arrested, so the kind stays enemy like the earlier stages.
In The Main Ingredient Luke and Danny visit Turk's shop, Luke smashes a bong to make him talk, Turk gives up the Stylers' grow house to be rid of them and Luke tells him to send a bill for it.

All Souled Out shows a real flashback of Scarfe and Misty searching Cockroach's apartment, with Scarfe planting the gun himself and Misty unaware; she then asks Ridenhour if Scarfe faked the evidence.
Claire never appears with Danny in Luke Cage S2; she is only mentioned when Danny says she asked him to check on Luke, and the owner's rule says a mention with no exchange is not a stage.
